mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary policy easing during economic distress, compressing discount rates and triggering positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as liquidity conditions improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (<1.0%) and high unemployment (>6.0%) indicate severe economic shock with aggressive policy support, triggering positive equity rebounds within 20 trading days as markets anticipate recovery.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 1.0 and UNRATE > 6.0.

mechanism_narrative: In post-crisis recovery phases, housing starts above 850 thousand units signal stabilizing consumer confidence and housing market strength, preceding positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 850 during post-crisis recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as corporate profit expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declines by at least 1.0% over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 800 thousand units signal contracting residential construction, reducing consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 800.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts below 800 thousand and industrial production below 100 index signal broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to severe earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 800 and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rates above 4.5% signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5 during monetary tightening.
